name: CMR consignment note
tagline: Turn an outbound load into a printable IRU-model CMR consignment note, in up to four languages at once.

screenshots.caption: The Create CMR button in the D365 action pane.
The CMR, filled from D365 and ready to print.
One CMR with German as the first language.

permissions.storage: Your settings, sender and carrier profiles, drafts and the CMR register.
permissions.scripting: Connects to D365 tabs that were already open, and runs on extra D365 sites you allow yourself.
permissions.downloads: Optional, asked only when you turn on saving a PDF of each printed CMR.
